levels.surface: محمد بن الحسين بن أبي الخطاب

notes: «9 -» is the report number; «أبي رحمه الله» is the compiler's father named only by relation, so it is a relation link; «جميعا» makes the three names co-transmitters of one level; the Imam Abu Ja'far is written inside the chain after «عن», so he stays narrator; «قال زرارة» and «قال رسول الله» in the matn are speakers of the saying, and the second «زرارة» is not a chain link
